title: E0062-1 The World Behind the Curtain
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken - low, quiet, intimate tone]
Who
are you?

[Verse 1]
The world
is full of secrets

Those with eyes will see
Those with ears will hear

[Verse 2]
Not the imitation made by others
But eyes and ears made by yourself
Then behind the world you see
The true faces and sounds
You will see and hear

[Bridge]
Without losing your mind
You cannot find
That secret

Reciting a script
Written by someone else
Like a parrot
Just living as if it were your own

[Outro]
The world
is full of secrets

Can you see
Can you hear

Can you face
The real you

The world
is still full of secrets

[End]
style: Korean soul ballad with smooth electric piano and mellow bass groove, warm expressive Japanese vocals with dynamic heartfelt delivery and subtle vibrato, slow-to-medium tempo, nostalgic reflective mood, deep plate reverb and short slapback
